about: Golden results for the synthetic diverse-layout fixtures (source/layout-*.html, generated by generate-layout-fixtures.mjs). All data is fictional. 'state' is the review row state: found (clear), review (candidate to check), missing (not printed or only near-misses), ambiguous (conflicting evidence, no value).

layout-cards.what: Mobile-portal card grid: label above value, deductions before earnings, synonyms, one-time holiday grant beside a recurring premium, car imputation beside the car deduction.

layout-ytd.what: Classic table with quantity, rate, this-month and year-to-date columns, mixed Hebrew/English labels, a retro difference, a bonus without stated recurrence, pension as an amount only, car benefit only, no credit points.

layout-multipage.what: Two pages: earnings on page 1; deductions, per-row employee/employer/severance contributions, tax data and cumulative bonus on page 2; an annual bonus beside a fixed bonus; credit-point value in shekels as a distractor.

layout-conflicts.what: Abstention: two different base salaries, two credit-point values in one row, employer-only pension, cumulative-only commissions, one-time grant only, car benefit only.
